headline: SITCON 2 (SEVERE): Chrome patches exploited zero-day; OpenSSH SSHole still exploited; four KEV additions due 11-12

bullets.text: Changed: SITCON rose from 3 to 2 (SEVERE), on 4 CISA KEV additions in 72 hours and 2 critical reports in 48 hours. New: a Chrome update patches an exploited XML zero-day, the eighth exploited Chrome zero-day this year.

SSHole (OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158, an authentication bypass) remains the top story across 5 outlets, with attackers using it to breach Linux systems. CISA added it to KEV on 11-09 with a federal due date of 11-12.

Also in KEV on 11-09, all due 11-12: GPUStack CVE-2026-102895 (a trusted-loopback check fooled by a reverse-proxy peer or the X-GPUStack-Real-IP header grants unauthenticated admin), SignalWire FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 (code injection) and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218.

Cloud trust abuse: attackers used Qubole's trusted access into customer AWS accounts to steal data, and trusted AWS integrations are being backdoored to steal secrets. ARTEX has gone from pentesting tool to attacker staple in three months.

N-able has taken its cloud platform offline after 30+ "zero-days" were published. Supply chain: Ethersphere's bee-js and Swarm Desktop were compromised to deliver wallet-stealing malware; 300 malicious packages hit the GitHub Advisory Database in 7 days, almost all npm.

Still developing: Vanderbilt University hit by ransomware via BYOD devices with data theft claimed; Beget rebuilding after a wiper attack; breaches at Iris Ohyama (7.7M), Frontline Education (3M+), Revolve (1.5M), Amplifon Americas (1.3M). 7 days ran 0.84x the 90-day average.

actions: Update Chrome on all endpoints to the latest release and restart browsers; confirm managed fleets have picked up the update.
Patch OpenSSH for CVE-2026-123158 on every internet-facing host; restrict SSH exposure and review auth logs for unexpected logins.
Patch or isolate GPUStack (CVE-2026-102895), FreeSwitch (CVE-2026-116779) and IBM Aspera Faspex (CVE-2026-123218) before the 11-12 KEV deadline.
Audit IAM roles that trust third-party AWS accounts; remove unused integrations such as Qubole and rotate secrets they could reach.
Scan your GitHub repos and history for committed secrets and rotate any found; treat machines with bee-js or Swarm Desktop as compromised.
Clear remaining KEV deadlines: VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 (11-11), Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 (11-13), SonicWall SSL-VPN CVE-2026-19868 (11-20).
